title: Reviewer sandbox detection removed; container is now the only wall
summary: This change deletes the runtime detection of whether osf is running inside the factory container, along with the codex read-only sandbox mode and the pre-flight sandbox check that gated a reviewer run. Codex now always runs with `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`, on the assumption that the container itself is the isolation boundary. In exchange, the review workflow gains a diagnostic escape hatch: `OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1` and `TMPDIR=/out/reviewer-home` are passed into each reviewer container, the reviewer's home is preserved instead of deleted, seeded logins are scrubbed from it, and the directory is uploaded as a per-agent artifact.

lanes.label: GitHub Actions workflow
lanes.subtitle: review.yml
lanes.summary: The three reviewer jobs now create a mounted reviewer-home directory, pass housekeeping environment variables into the container, and upload the kept home as an artifact.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf
lanes.summary: The review runner no longer probes for the factory container or runs a sandbox check; it always selects the in-container mode and can keep a reviewer's home for diagnosis.

lanes.label: Reviewer agent
lanes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode
lanes.summary: Codex loses its read-only sandbox mode and always runs with approvals and sandbox bypassed, relying on the container as the wall.

lanes.label: Artifacts
lanes.subtitle: uploaded diagnostics
lanes.summary: Each reviewer job uploads its kept home directory as a separate artifact, never as journal or posted output.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: reviewer job matrix
nodes.summary: Defines the codex, claude and opencode reviewer jobs. Each now pre-creates out/reviewer-home, passes OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME and TMPDIR into the container, and uploads the resulting home.

nodes.label: Reviewer container
nodes.subtitle: REVIEW_IMAGE, /pr read-only
nodes.summary: The container that runs `osf review run`. It now receives TMPDIR pointing at the mounted out/reviewer-home and OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME=1, so its temporary and home files land on the host mount.

nodes.label: review-home artifact
nodes.subtitle: review-home-codex / -claude / -opencode
nodes.summary: Per-agent artifact uploaded with `if: always()` from out/reviewer-home, carrying the reviewer's own session and child output for diagnosis.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: reviewers::run_one
nodes.summary: The review entry point. It no longer calls check_sandbox before starting a reviewer, and it now scrubs seeded logins from a kept home after the child exits.

nodes.label: roster
nodes.subtitle: reviewers::roster
nodes.summary: Builds the reviewer list from osf.toml. The container-detection parameter is gone; each reviewer is constructed directly in its own container mode.

nodes.label: Reviewer::from_agent
nodes.subtitle: read_only = in_container.or(read_only)
nodes.summary: No longer branches on in_factory_container. It picks the in-container read-only mode when the agent has one, otherwise the agent's own read-only mode, and drops the sandbox_check field entirely.

nodes.label: keep_home / forget_login
nodes.subtitle: OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME
nodes.summary: keep_home reads the environment variable; RunHome::drop preserves the directory when it is set. forget_login removes seeded login paths from a kept home so credentials do not ride out with the diagnostic record.

nodes.label: run_child
nodes.subtitle: spawns the agent process
nodes.summary: Spawns the reviewer agent, drains stderr without reading it, cleans up, and now calls forget_login on the home before returning.

nodes.label: in_factory_container
nodes.subtitle: marker_trusted / facts_of
nodes.summary: The marker-based detection of the factory container, its trust rules and all their tests are deleted. Nothing decides reviewer mode from the machine any more.

nodes.label: check_sandbox
nodes.subtitle: SANDBOX_CHECK_LIMIT
nodes.summary: The pre-flight command that started the agent's read-only sandbox around a harmless command, with its timeout and stderr reason, is gone. A reviewer is no longer gated on its sandbox starting.

nodes.label: codex
nodes.subtitle: --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox
nodes.summary: Codex loses its `--sandbox read-only` mode and its sandbox_check. It always runs with approvals and sandbox bypassed, because the container is treated as the wall.

nodes.label: claude
nodes.subtitle: file tools only, no shell
nodes.summary: Claude keeps its own read-only mode and login paths; only the shared sandbox_check field it never used is gone.

nodes.label: opencode
nodes.subtitle: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
nodes.summary: Opencode is unaffected apart from the removed sandbox_check field and the new housekeeping environment in its job.

nodes.label: review_workflow tests
nodes.subtitle: HOUSEKEEPING_ENV
nodes.summary: Workflow tests now filter TMPDIR and OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME out of the credential assertions and assert codex has no read-only mode of its own.

nodes.label: reviewers tests
nodes.subtitle: sandbox-check fixtures removed
nodes.summary: The fake sandbox check, its success/failure/hang cases and the roster_in container-detection tests are deleted; the roster test now asserts codex runs with its own sandbox off.

edges.label: TMPDIR, OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME
edges.summary: The workflow now injects the housekeeping environment that makes the reviewer's home land on the mounted out/reviewer-home.

edges.label: osf review run
edges.summary: The container still invokes the osf review entry point; only the environment around it changed.
run_one builds its reviewer list through roster, which no longer takes a container-detection flag.
Each selected agent is turned into a Reviewer without consulting in_factory_container.

edges.label: in_container mode
edges.summary: Codex now always resolves to its in-container mode, so the bypass flag is unconditional.
run_one goes straight to run_child; the sandbox check that used to precede it is gone.

edges.label: spawn
edges.summary: The agent process is spawned with the resolved read-only arguments and the reviewer's prepared home.

edges.label: forget_login
edges.summary: After the child exits, run_child scrubs seeded logins from the home when it is being kept.

edges.label: kept home
edges.summary: A preserved home is what the workflow uploads as the per-agent diagnostic artifact.
The pre-flight sandbox check that could stop a reviewer before its agent started has been deleted.
Roster construction no longer asks whether osf runs inside the factory container.
The workflow tests read review.yml and now tolerate the two housekeeping variables alongside the single credential.
Reviewer tests exercise roster directly instead of the removed roster_in variant.

flows.title: One reviewer run with a kept home
flows.summary: How a single reviewer job now runs: the workflow seeds the housekeeping environment, osf spawns the agent in its container mode, and the home survives for upload.

messages.label: reviewer in its container mode
messages.note: The sandbox check that used to run here has been removed.
